_about: Jurisdiction words that a country-name lookup does not resolve, mapped to the codes GLEIF uses for an entity's legal jurisdiction: ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes where companies are formed under state or provincial law (United States, Canada), and the ISO 3166-1 country code for the parts of the United Kingdom, whose companies are registered nationally. Country names are resolved by the country lookup, so only these words are listed; 'Georgia' is the US state, which is far more common in US filings than the country. Keys are matched without regard to case, punctuation or a leading 'State of' / 'Province of'. Sources: ISO 3166-2:US and ISO 3166-2:CA (https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#iso:code:3166:US, https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#iso:code:3166:CA); GLEIF Level 1 data, LegalJurisdiction (https://www.gleif.org/en/about-lei/common-data-file-format/current-versions/level-1-data-lei-cdf-3-1-format).
